CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adc2_account_identity() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (NEW.id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.asset_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.beneficial) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.owner_id,OLD.asset_id,OLD.purpose,OLD.beneficial) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_immutable_account_identity'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adc2_immutable_commercial() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_immutable_commercial_record'; END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adc2_immutable_journal() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.state='sealed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_immutable_journal'; END IF; IF (NEW.id,NEW.asset_id,NEW.economic_key,NEW.payload_hash,NEW.kind,NEW.created_ms) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.asset_id,OLD.economic_key,OLD.payload_hash,OLD.kind,OLD.created_ms) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_immutable_journal'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adc2_immutable_posting() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE journal_state TEXT; BEGIN IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_immutable_posting'; END IF; SELECT state INTO journal_state FROM adc2_journals WHERE id=NEW.journal_id FOR UPDATE; IF journal_state<>'pending' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_closed_journal'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION adc2_validate_journal() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE header adc2_journals%ROWTYPE; n BIGINT; total NUMERIC; BEGIN SELECT * INTO header FROM adc2_journals WHERE id=NEW.id; SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(delta_atoms),0) INTO n,total FROM adc2_postings WHERE journal_id=NEW.id; IF header.state<>'sealed' OR n<2 OR total<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'adc2_unbalanced_journal'; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $$

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adc2_postings (journal_id TEXT NOT NULL, line_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_no>=0), asset_id TEXT NOT NULL, account_id TEXT NOT NULL, delta_atoms NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (delta_atoms=trunc(delta_atoms) AND delta_atoms<>0 AND delta_atoms BETWEEN -115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 AND 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935), PRIMARY KEY(journal_id,line_no), FOREIGN KEY(journal_id,asset_id) REFERENCES adc2_journals(id,asset_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id,asset_id) REFERENCES adc2_accounts(id,asset_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adc2_principals (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES adc2_authority_guards(guard_id), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('human','agent','ops')), owner_id TEXT, capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (((kind IN ('human','agent')) AND owner_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind='ops' AND owner_id IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adc2_receipt_keys (kid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','verify_only','revoked')), not_before_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, verify_until_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (verify_until_ms>not_before_ms), public_x TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adc2_receipts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, journal_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES adc2_journals(id), offer_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, agent_binding_id TEXT, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adc2_assets(id), user_reward_atoms NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (user_reward_atoms=trunc(user_reward_atoms) AND user_reward_atoms BETWEEN 1 AND 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935), quote_hash TEXT NOT NULL, issued_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, signature_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (signature_state IN ('pending','signed')), key_id TEXT, jws TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(offer_id,owner_id) REFERENCES adc2_offers(id,owner_id), CHECK ((signature_state='pending' AND key_id IS NULL AND jws IS NULL) OR (signature_state='signed' AND key_id IS NOT NULL AND jws IS NOT NULL)))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adc2_report_consumptions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, advertiser_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adc2_advertisers(id), principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adc2_principals(id), report_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision>=1), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('received','missing','unreadable','content_mismatch')), observed_digest TEXT, recorded_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(report_id,revision) REFERENCES adc2_report_revisions(id,revision))
